description:
Stop moths ruining your clothes and carpets.
Ready Steady Defend Moth Killer Spray is a fast-acting formula developed to kill moths on contact and provide ongoing protection against infestations. Our complete treatment works for both clothes and carpet moth infestations. The water-based solution contains 0.1% cypermethrin, a synthetic pyrethroid that emulates a naturally occurring compound of chrysanthemum flowers. These properties make the spray a powerful insecticide that targets every stage of the moth life cycle while remaining approved for use on soft and hard furnishings. Non-staining and low-odour, Ready Steady Defend Moth Killer Spray is a spot treatment and long-lasting defence barrier. The solution treats the applied area for up to 12 weeks and can be reapplied whenever required.

How to get rid of moths in your home
Warm homes and full wardrobes are perfect breeding grounds for moths. For best results, use Ready Steady Defend Moth Killer Spray as part of a complete elimination strategy.

Step 1: Spot the signs of infestation
Inspect clothes and carpets for:

  • Holes and frayed fibres (particularly in organic fabrics)
  • Small maggot-like larvae
  • Moth cases (silken tubes)
  • Silk cocoons (pupae)

Step 2: Clean the affected area
Wash clothes and carpets where possible. Regularly vacuum clothes and carpets and clean surrounding areas (e.g., wardrobes, drawers, cupboards, skirting boards, etc.).

Step 3: Apply Ready Steady Defend Moth Killer
Spray directly on affected and surrounding areas to kill moths and help prevent their return.*
*Always read the product label before use.
